name: io.github.mgcrea/mcp-apple-maps
title: Apple Maps
description: Read Apple Maps — favourites, Guides and recents; writes only when Cupertino hosts it

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_MAPS_ALLOW_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Register the five write tools, which exist only when Cupertino hosts this server: run with npx it registers none, as this package writes nothing to Maps on its own. Off by default, and the gate decides whether the write tools exist at all rather than merely refusing.
